terms.definition: The energy transferred to electrical energy per unit charge passing through the source, ε = E/Q.
terms.examiner: Equal to the terminal pd when no current flows.

terms.definition: The resistance of the source itself, which causes energy to be wasted inside it when current flows.
terms.examiner: ε = I(R + r); the 'lost volts' are Ir.

terms.definition: The pd across the terminals of a source when it supplies current, V = ε − Ir.
terms.examiner: From a V–I graph: intercept = emf, gradient = −r.
